items.content_html: ReWatch is a Chrome extension that automatically tracks playback progress across Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, HiAnime, YouTube, Tubi, Pluto TV, Crunchyroll, The Roku Channel, Plex, and Filmzie. It saves where you left off for each title, surfaces that history in a lightweight popup UI, and lets you resume or manage entries with a single click.
